title: Olive Finds the Gift
note: b415 — Phase 4 (Learning) — consonant clusters ft, lt, lf.

pages.brief: Olive the owl holding a small soft cloth-wrapped gift in her nest.
Olive the owl flying away from her tree hollow towards the garden.
The small soft gift slipping out and landing on the garden path behind Olive.
Olive the owl walking on along the path, not noticing the empty space in her claws.
Olive the owl turning around and walking back along the path, looking down.
Olive the owl spotting a small soft lump among blades of grass by the path.
Close view of the small soft cloth-wrapped gift lying safe in the grass.
Olive the owl smiling, holding the gift safely again.
Olive the owl flying home with the gift held carefully in her claws.
